subject: CPPO: technical evidence collection & go-live timeline for Nimbus reseller listing
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@nimbuscloud.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff – initial evidence + billing entity

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. To keep the CPPO activation moving toward our planned 3/23 launch, I've attached the SOC 2 summary and our preferred invoice entity details. Quick items where we need Redwood's help: 

- Verification of SKU entitlement mapping (which Redwood SKU maps to our reseller SKU).
- Confirmation that the invoice entity on the private offer will be Nimbus Cloud Solutions, Inc. (EIN attached).
- A copy of any AWS CPPO evidence template you require (if Redwood has a standard package, that speeds AWS review).

Attachments: nimbus-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB); nimbus-invoice-entity.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

High level timeline from our side: sign PO/DocuSign by 3/13 -> AWS CPPO submission 3/14 -> expected approval window 5–7 business days -> targeted marketplace go-live 3/23 (contingent on AWS fast-path).

Would appreciate a short internal note from Redwood listing the missing technical evidence items so we can gather immediately.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Channel Ops | Nimbus Cloud Solutions
ops@nimbuscloud.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@nimbuscloud.com>, Nimbus Cloud Solutions <ops@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff – initial evidence + billing entity

Sara — thanks for the packet and timeline. Looping in Ben (partnership ops) and Vanessa (billing/entitlements) so we can quickly close open items. To be explicit, here are the Redwood actions and asks from Nimbus: 

Redwood action items (we'll own these):
- Ben to validate SKU <-> entitlement mapping and return mapping spreadsheet by EOD 3/10.
- Vanessa to confirm invoice routing and whether AWS will see Nimbus as the bill-to vs Redwood as the payor (we need this to set the contract metadata).
- I will attach the Redwood CPPO evidence bundle that AWS expects and flag any gaps.

Nimbus asks for us:
- Confirm the exact SKU code Redwood will list in the CPPO (final mapping).
- Provide the preferred DocuSign flow (DocuSign link vs signed PDF) you want used for the PO.

We aim to publish the CPPO submission to AWS on 3/14 if we have mapping + signed PO by COB 3/13. If any of the evidence requires more than the SOC-2 summary (e.g., KMS/HSM evidence or encryption-in-transit diagrams), call that out now so Nimbus can source it.

I'll attach the Redwood CPPO template to this thread in a sec.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff – initial evidence + billing entity

Kimberly / Sara — quick technical clarifications from entitlement side: 

- Proposed SKU mapping: REDW-ENT-2000 (per-seat) -> Nimbus Reseller SKU NIM-RS-ENT-01. I attached a one-tab mapping CSV stub for visibility. If Nimbus plans to meter differently (monthly vs committed annual) call it out and we will adjust the plan level.
- Entitlement split: Redwood will mark Nimbus as the reseller payee on the CPPO (AWS shows reseller entity on the private offer). Vanessa — can you confirm any changes needed to the invoice metadata to support that?
- Caching/latency delta note: Because Nimbus will be routing inference through their co-sell integration, make sure you validate expected latency SLA in your internal staging tests — if Nimbus wants, we can schedule a short bench test on our dedicated pool next week.

Attachment: sku-mapping-stub.csv (csv, 2KB)

If Nimbus confirms mapping and signs PO by 3/13, I will queue the CPPO submission 3/14 and mark it as high-priority with AWS.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@nimbuscloud.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, AWS CPPO Team <aws-cppo@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff – initial evidence + billing entity

Thanks all — this is great. Confirming: we accept REDW-ENT-2000 -> NIM-RS-ENT-01 mapping.

Open items we will deliver by EOD 3/12:
- Signed PO via DocuSign (we will use the provided DocuSign link).
- Full SOC-2 report (redacted) if that speeds AWS review — we will upload to the shared Drive link once legal OKs.
- Point of contact for bench test and a preferred 1hr window next week (nominate 3/15 morning PT).

Two small asks for Redwood:
1) Vanessa — please confirm whether AWS CPPO will display Nimbus as invoice recipient (so our accounting can reconcile).
2) Kimberly — can you upload the Redwood CPPO evidence bundle and the DocuSign flow to HubSpot deal 4729 so we have a single source of truth?

Attachments: nimbus-docusign-ppo.pdf (pdf stub, 40KB)

Sara Lin
Head of Channel Ops | Nimbus Cloud Solutions
ops@nimbuscloud.com
